name: ether0_reasoning
description: Call the ether0 chemistry reasoning model (futurehouse/ether0) over MCP. Provide a chemistry question; receive reasoning and an answer parsed from the model's XML-style tags when present.

prompt.description: Natural-language chemistry prompt (synthesis planning, reaction analysis, safety, etc.).

system_prompt.description: Optional system instruction override; defaults to a chemistry-focused prompt that requests <|think|> and <|answer|> tags.

answer.description: Parsed <|answer_start|>...<|answer_end|> content; falls back to the raw completion when parsing fails.

thought.description: Parsed <|think_start|>...<|think_end|> reasoning if emitted by the model.

raw_completion.description: Full decoded generation with prompt stripped off.

context_info.description: Metadata about the generation (model id, decoding params, parse notes).
